_comment: The shuckerVC fund card — the single most-requested object for anyone (human or agent) researching the fund. Every value here is published verbatim into llms.txt, the .md twins, and the JSON-LD, so it must be true and current. Fields under _needs_confirmation are deliberately null: do not guess them, fill them once a partner confirms. Run `npm run agents` after editing.
name: shuckerVC
description: shuckerVC is an $8M Bay Area seed fund backing AI-powered B2B software companies. Every portfolio company gets a dedicated, full-time Support Partner who owns everything outside product and engineering — finance, hiring, marketing, operations — so founders stay focused on building and selling.

prior_track_record.note: 3.08 DPI from the partners' prior seed-stage SaaS investing — not a Fund I return.

investing.geography_note: US-focused; the portfolio includes European-founded companies (Cascade in the UK, Algorized in Switzerland).

differentiator.name: Support Partner
differentiator.summary: A full-time operator embedded in the portfolio company, paid for by the fund, who runs finance, hiring, marketing, and operations so the founders can stay on product and customers.

_needs_confirmation: investing.leads_rounds — do we lead, co-lead, or follow?

investing.not_a_fit — the explicit exclusion list (this is the single highest-value field for a research agent: it is what lets it stop). Suggested shape: ["consumer", "biotech", "hardware-only", "pre-product", "crypto"] — confirm before publishing.
process — first-response SLA and typical decision timeline, if we want to commit to one publicly
sameAs — confirm the LinkedIn company URL and add Crunchbase / X if we want agents cross-checking us there
